reviewed_context_transfers.basis: Native instruction bodies match the reviewed same-release Lua context boundaries byte for byte through their transfer instruction.

reviewed_pic_state_anchors.basis: Immutable native PC constants and their immutable scalar aliases plus constant offsets resolving into module data.

reviewed_virtual_owner_calls.basis: Deleting destructor slot and reference-count guarded control-block release preserve the native owner argument.

reviewed_public_float_bits.basis: Public asFloat returns IEEE-754 bits in R0/R1; native VMOV instructions reinterpret the joined words rather than numerically converting them.

reviewed_numeric_conversion.basis: Native ARM soft-float argument is R0/R1. Both helpers greedily subtract powers of two from bit 63 through bit 0; signed conversion applies the sign after accumulating the magnitude.

reviewed_division_register_views.basis: Native fabs returns magnitude bits through R0/R1; integer modulo stores its integer result unchanged in the numeric payload.

_wm_probe_heap_add_region.declaration: bool add_region(unsigned long address,unsigned long size);

_wm_probe_heap_add_regions.declaration: bool add_regions(unsigned long *addresses,unsigned long *sizes,unsigned long count);

_wm_probe_heap_alloc_range.declaration: void *alloc_range(unsigned long size,unsigned long first,unsigned long last);

reviewed_interpreter_result_dispatch.basis: Native bounded variant result dispatch adds native table PC to stored relative offsets. Source literal-array addresses differ and must not participate in native case selection.

reviewed_decimal_conversion.basis: Native VMOV moves R1/R2 into D8. The magnitude is converted through unsigned soft-float helpers, and the fractional digits use (magnitude - integer_value) * 1000000 + 0.5.
